name: Cooperation programme with Mexico (SECIHTI – Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación) Master
summary: The aim of this joint scholarship programme of DAAD and SECIHTI is to support the qualification and employability of young academics and future professionals from Mexico.
